clue.text: With difficulty, careless male reportedly made kids food

parts.note: being in a hole means being in difficulty

indicators.note: careless suggests the letters of male are thrown about any old how
reportedly signals that the word for made kids is to be heard, not read

parts.note: to breed is to produce young; made kids is bred

explanation.surface: A clumsy man, so people say, produced some children with great difficulty.
explanation.walkthrough: 'careless' rearranges MALE into MEAL; 'reportedly' turns BRED (made kids) into its sound-alike BREAD.
explanation.definitionFit: Bread made from whole grain flour is a staple item of food.

clue.text: Criticising this writer in amateur band

parts.note: a ham is an amateur, as in a ham actor or radio ham
the setter referring to themself is ME
a ring is a band, as worn on a finger

explanation.surface: Someone slates the setter for playing in a bunch of amateur musicians.
explanation.walkthrough: 'band' looks like a music group but is a circlet, as on a finger; 'in' is only a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: Giving something a hammering means attacking it harshly in words, so it is informal for severe criticism.

clue.text: Claim sites regularly ignored schedules

indicators.note: regularly ignored says every other letter of claim sites is dropped, keeping the rest

explanation.surface: Planning timetables routinely overlooked claims made on various sites.
explanation.walkthrough: Dropping the first, third, fifth letters and so on of CLAIM SITES leaves L, I, S, T, S.
explanation.definitionFit: Schedules and lists are both itemised written records, as of tasks or prices, so they are synonyms as nouns.

clue.text: Changes to secure the Italian ruins

indicators.note: to secure is to hold something fast, so one piece holds the other inside it

parts.note: mutates means changes form
il is the Italian for the

explanation.surface: Alterations are made to protect old Italian ruins.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ruins' reads as a noun about Italian antiquities but is the verb, meaning wrecks.
explanation.definitionFit: To mutilate something is to damage it badly, so it spoils or wrecks it.

clue.text: Shining silver base

parts.note: Ag is the chemical symbol for silver
base means low, lowly or mean

explanation.surface: A gleaming silver stand or pedestal.
explanation.definitionFit: Something aglow is glowing with light or colour, which is to be shining brightly.

clue.text: Musicians sack Greek character, person shunning working

parts.note: a sack is a bag
pi is a letter of the Greek alphabet

indicators.note: shunning means avoiding, so the following word is kept out of person

parts.note: on means working, as a machine that is switched on

explanation.surface: Players sack a Greek fellow who refuses to work.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sack' looks like dismissal but is a bag; PERSON without ON leaves PERS.
explanation.definitionFit: Players of the bagpipes, such as Scottish pipers, are musicians.

clue.text: Antelope dash over delta

indicators.note: in a down clue over means the first piece sits on top of the next

parts.note: dash means style and flair, which is elan
Delta is the radio alphabet word for D

explanation.surface: An antelope sprints across a river delta.
explanation.definitionFit: The eland is a large African species of antelope with spiral horns.

clue.text: Win diamonds, West's partner with ace, perhaps

parts.note: D is the card abbreviation for diamonds
in bridge, West partners East, abbreviated E
an ace in tennis is one kind of serve

explanation.surface: A bridge player takes a trick in diamonds with East holding an ace.
explanation.walkthrough: The bridge setting misleads: 'ace' switches to tennis, where an ace is an unreturned serve.
explanation.definitionFit: To deserve something is to have earned or merited it, so win in the sense of gaining by merit.

clue.text: Relation receives second degree

indicators.note: receives means takes in, so one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: an aunt is a family relation
a mo is a moment, a second

explanation.surface: A family member gets a second university degree.
explanation.walkthrough: 'second degree' reads as a qualification; 'degree' is the definition, in its sense of extent.
explanation.definitionFit: Degree and amount both mean the extent or quantity of something, as in a certain degree of risk.

clue.text: Pressure on parent with son's disease

indicators.note: on means placed after, so the pressure letter follows the parent

parts.note: mum is a mother, a parent
P is the physics symbol for pressure
S is a genealogical abbreviation for son

explanation.surface: Stress weighs on a mother whose son is ill.
explanation.definitionFit: Mumps is a contagious viral illness that swells the glands of the neck.

clue.text: Messages from European before stage in public transport

indicators.note: in places the joined pieces inside the transport word

parts.note: trams are a form of public transport

indicators.note: before places the European letter ahead of the stage

parts.note: a leg is a stage of a journey or race

explanation.surface: Messages arrive from a European just ahead of a leg of a journey on public transport.
explanation.definitionFit: Telegrams were short written communications sent by wire, so they are messages.

clue.text: Reconfigured iTunes, primarily listening tool

indicators.note: reconfigured means set up in a new arrangement, so the letters of iTunes are reordered
primarily means in the first place, so only the opening letter of listening is used

explanation.surface: Reset iTunes, which is mainly a tool for listening to music.
explanation.definitionFit: A utensil is an implement, especially a kitchen tool, so the two are synonyms.

clue.text: Stranger beginning to watch duck crossing river

indicators.note: beginning to means the first letter of the next word
crossing means straddling, so the duck word goes around the river letter

parts.note: an eider is a sea duck
R is a map abbreviation for river

explanation.surface: A newcomer starts to watch a duck swimming across a river.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Stranger' looks like a person but is the comparative adjective: more strange.
explanation.definitionFit: Weirder is the comparative of weird, meaning more odd or peculiar, exactly as stranger does.

clue.text: Hears shots

definitions.meaning: a court hears a case, putting it on trial
shots are attempts, as in having a go at something

explanation.surface: Someone picks up the sound of gunfire.
explanation.definitionFit: A judge tries a case when hearing it; tries are also attempts, as shots at doing something are.

clue.text: Loss of order, impacted by hard season in America

indicators.note: impacted by means packed in with, so the hard letter goes inside the order word

parts.note: to sort is to order
H is the pencil abbreviation for hard
fall is the American word for autumn

explanation.surface: A disruption to order, made worse by a tough American autumn.
explanation.definitionFit: A shortfall is a deficit, the amount by which something falls short, so a loss.

clue.text: Perhaps dishes from Alberta we cooked

indicators.note: cooked as in cooked the books, falsified, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Some food we cooked from Alberta, maybe served in dishes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cooked' suits the kitchen picture but is the signal to rearrange ALBERTA WE.
explanation.definitionFit: Dishes are one example of tableware, the plates, cutlery and glasses used at a meal.

clue.text: Belgium dominant playing sport

parts.note: B is the international vehicle code for Belgium

indicators.note: playing suggests the letters of dominant are moved about freely

explanation.surface: Belgium is dominant when playing a sport.
explanation.definitionFit: Badminton is a racket sport played with a shuttlecock over a high net.

clue.text: A new king in rebuilt castle of family line

indicators.note: rebuilt means constructed again, so the letters are put together in a new order

parts.note: R is for rex, Latin for king

explanation.surface: A new monarch moves into a reconstructed castle belonging to the dynasty.
explanation.walkthrough: The rebuilding takes in the king's R with CASTLE, giving CESTRAL.
explanation.definitionFit: Ancestral means relating to one's forebears, so it describes things of the family line.

clue.text: Involved in goal, nasty left- winger from Everton

indicators.note: in places the joined pieces within the goal word

parts.note: an end is an aim or goal
gross means nasty or disgusting

indicators.note: the left wing of a word is its first letter

explanation.surface: A football report: a nasty left-winger from Everton was involved in a goal.
explanation.walkthrough: The football picture hides the job of 'left-winger from', which takes the first letter of Everton, an English Premier League club from Liverpool.
explanation.definitionFit: Engrossed means absorbed in something, deeply involved or occupied with it.

clue.text: Draws scene, it is abstract

indicators.note: abstract art departs from realism, so the letters are not kept in their real order

explanation.surface: An artist sketches a scene in the abstract style.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Draws' looks like the artist at work but means lures.
explanation.definitionFit: To draw someone in is to attract or lure them, which is what entices means.

clue.text: Horrors after husband's removed footwear

indicators.note: removed means taken away, so a letter is dropped

parts.note: shocks are horrors

explanation.surface: Awful scenes after a husband takes off his shoes.
explanation.definitionFit: Socks are knitted coverings worn on the feet, an item of footwear.

clue.text: Unexpected upset after university ousts adult

indicators.note: ousts means pushes out and takes the place of, so one letter replaces another

parts.note: to sadden is to upset
A is the old film rating for adult

explanation.surface: A shock to an adult pushed out by a university.
explanation.definitionFit: Sudden means happening quickly and without warning, so unexpected.

clue.text: Vehicle to go off with trailer in reverse

indicators.note: in reverse means backwards, so the joined words are read from the end

parts.note: to rot is to go off, as food does
a cart is a trailer pulled behind

explanation.surface: A vehicle drives off, reversing with a trailer attached.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in reverse' fits a driving picture but turns ROTCART round.
explanation.definitionFit: A tractor is a powerful farm vehicle used for pulling machinery.

clue.text: A furore about male's management

indicators.note: about means around, so the noise word surrounds the male letter

parts.note: a din is a loud uproar, a furore

explanation.surface: An uproar over a man's handling of a company.
explanation.definitionFit: Admin, short for administration, is the work of managing an organisation.

clue.text: Fish from right cook with head removed

indicators.note: with head removed means the first letter of the cooking word is dropped

parts.note: to poach is to cook gently in liquid

explanation.surface: Fish from the right person to cook, headless.
explanation.definitionFit: The roach is a European freshwater fish of the carp family.

clue.text: Cut in members of police around south-east

indicators.note: around means surrounding, so the police letters go round the compass letters

parts.note: the CID, the Criminal Investigation Department, is a branch of the British police
SE is the compass abbreviation for south-east

explanation.surface: Officers are cut in on a deal around the south-east of England.
explanation.walkthrough: CID is the plain-clothes detective branch of the British police.
explanation.definitionFit: Incised means carved or engraved into a surface, so cut.

clue.text: Lead one hundred on island to the north

parts.note: C is the Roman numeral for one hundred

indicators.note: to the north in a down clue means going upwards, so the island is read backwards

parts.note: Elba is the Mediterranean island of Napoleon's exile

explanation.surface: A hundred people head north to an island.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Lead' looks like a verb but is the noun: a flex or wire.
explanation.definitionFit: A lead is an electrical flex or wire, which is a cable.

clue.text: Person hugging cudgel in bed is fighter

indicators.note: in puts the hugging pair inside the bed word

parts.note: man is a person
a bat is a club, a cudgel

explanation.surface: Someone lying in bed clutching a club is ready for a fight.
explanation.definitionFit: A combatant is someone taking part in a fight or war, a fighter.

clue.text: Transported spy in film, not family-rated

indicators.note: not means without, so the rating letter is taken out

parts.note: Jason Bourne is the spy in the Bourne films
U is the British film certificate for universal, suitable for all the family

explanation.surface: A film spy is shipped off, unsuitable for a family audience.
explanation.walkthrough: U (universal) is the British film certificate for all ages.

clue.text: Ending day's hell getting drunk alone

indicators.note: getting drunk means becoming befuddled, so the letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: Finishing a dreadful day by drinking alone.
explanation.definitionFit: Doing something single-handedly means doing it without help, on one's own.
